paragraphs.text: Coracin was the place Davvol came from.

The inhabitants of Coracin worshipped an ancient artifact named the " Gift of the Gods ", an item of Thran , or possibly Phyrexian , origin housed in the most sacred temple on the plane. Coracin is either the name of Davvol's plane or the name of a nation on that plane , but since it was not mentioned on Brady Dommermuth 's list, the latter is more likely. The inhabitants of Coracin commonly possessed innate mental powers. Davvol's ability to read surface thoughts, even among the Coracin, was unique. The people of Coracin had wide skulls, the bones of which never fully joined.
